row.evidence: GitHub's pricing page lists "User provisioning through SCIM" and "SAML single sign-on" only under Enterprise (starting at $21 per user/month); the docs say SCIM for organizations needs SAML SSO, which requires GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: Free $0, Team $4, Enterprise from $21 per user/month (the pricing page shows per user/month with no separate annual price). Two SCIM implementations, both on Enterprise Cloud: (1) organization SCIM for SAML-SSO orgs with personal accounts (Users only, Entra/Okta/OneLogin, needs an OAuth-app token from an org owner who consumes a seat); (2) Enterprise Managed Users (EMU) SCIM with Users and Groups, via partner IdP apps (Entra, Okta, PingFederate) or the open SCIM REST API with a non-expiring scim:enterprise PAT. EMU deprovisioning suspends (soft) or permanently suspends and scrubs (hard, DELETE); suspended managed users do not consume a licence. Okta + Entra mixed SSO/SCIM is explicitly unsupported. Org member, team and role REST APIs are available on all plans; Audit Log API is Enterprise.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Enterprise Cloud; includes Enterprise Managed Users. Enterprise Server is also offered at the same tier.

auth.token_source: EMU: personal access token (classic) with scim:enterprise scope created by the SHORTCODE_admin setup user. Organization SCIM: OAuth 2.0 bearer token of an organization owner (PAT classic needs admin:org and SAML SSO authorization).
auth.notes: EMU docs say the token must have no expiration. Organization SCIM stops working if the authorizing user leaves the org.

endpoints.notes: Groups are documented only for the EMU (enterprise) implementation; organization SCIM documents Users only.

deprovision.data_retained: EMU soft-deprovision (active=false): account suspended, username hashed, email obfuscated (except with Entra), SCIM identity kept, reversible. Hard-deprovision (DELETE): permanent suspension, user's repos, PATs, SSH/GPG keys and SCIM attributes deleted; comments and other resources created by the user are retained. A deprovisioned account is never deleted from the enterprise. Organization SCIM removes the member from the organization.

filtering.notes: eq only; multiple filters not supported.

pagination.notes: startIndex and count; count defaults to 30.

roles.how: EMU: SCIM roles attribute (set via the IdP app's Roles attribute) maps to enterprise roles; IdP groups map to teams and organization membership.

rate_limits.text: Do not assign more than 1,000 users per hour to the SCIM integration (or add more than 1,000 users per group per hour); otherwise provisioning may fail with rate-limit errors.

limitations.text: Okta and Entra ID combined for SSO and SCIM (either order) is explicitly not supported.
REST API SCIM provisioning is not supported for enterprises enabled for OIDC.
PATCH path selectors containing filters (e.g. emails[type eq "work"]) are not supported.
Organization SCIM cannot be used with an enterprise account or an organization with managed users; it needs an OAuth app authorized by an org owner who consumes a licence.

capabilities.notes: Non-SCIM APIs manage organization membership of existing GitHub accounts; they do not create accounts. delete_user = remove from organization.

endpoints.purpose: Get organization membership for a user
Set organization membership / role for a user
Remove organization membership for a user
Add or update team membership for a user
Remove team membership for a user
Assign an organization role to a user
Remove an organization role from a user
Get the audit log for an organization (Enterprise Cloud)

rate_limits.text: 5,000 requests per hour per user (15,000 for apps owned by an Enterprise Cloud org); org audit-log endpoint 1,750 queries per hour per user and IP; 50 invitations per 24h for new free orgs, 500 otherwise.

limitations.text: Team membership changes via API error when team synchronization with an IdP is set up for the team.

okta.notes: GitHub Enterprise Managed User app: SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking. Okta is also listed for organization SCIM.

entra.notes: Microsoft's tutorial says provisioning is only for EMU, not standard enterprise accounts; GitHub lists Entra as compatible with organization SCIM (see conflicts).

google.notes: Google Workspace is not among GitHub's tested SAML IdPs or SCIM-compatible IdPs; no Google catalogue page was checked.

onelogin.notes: From GitHub's own docs (organization SCIM compatible IdPs, tested SAML IdPs); OneLogin connector page not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud also documents a separate GitHub Enterprise Cloud - Enterprise Accounts connector.

fallbacks.other_sync: Team synchronization with IdP groups (Enterprise Cloud)
fallbacks.notes: With org-level SAML SSO, users can join without an invitation via https://github.com/orgs/ORGANIZATION/sso/sign_up.
